保存界面语言、License、可信时间和授权校验状态。: Stores the interface language, License, trusted time, and license validation status.

保留在浏览器中，直到用户点击“清空当前题库”、覆盖导入，或清除目标网站的本地浏览: Retained in the browser until the user clicks “Clear Current Question Bank,” imports a replacement, or clears the local browsing data for the target website.
本扩展面向获授权的业务或培训场景，并非面向儿童设计。我们不会故意收集儿童的个人信: This extension is intended for authorized business or training use and is not designed for children. We do not knowingly collect children's personal information.
本隐私政策仅适用于由 Tools Platform 提供的“题库与答题助手”浏览: This Privacy Policy applies only to the “Question Bank & Answering Assistant” browser extension provided by Tools Platform. 本政策说明“题库与答题助手”浏览器扩展如何访问考试页面内容、在您的浏览器中保存题: This policy explains how the “Question Bank & Answering Assistant” browser extension accesses exam page content, stores question banks in your browser, and performs License validation.
当前考试页面中的题目、题型、题号、选项、正确/错误反馈和答题结果。: Questions, question types, question numbers, options, correct/incorrect feedback, and answer results on the current exam page.
将题库与答题功能注入当前目标考试页面。: Inject question bank and answering features into the current target exam page.
界面语言、关闭行为、本地 License、可信时间缓存和校验状态。: Interface language, close behavior, local License, trusted time cache, and validation status.
仅在当前标签页本地处理: Processed locally in the current tab only
考试内容和题库在本地处理，扩展不会将其发送到 Tools Platform 或其: Exam content and question banks are processed locally. The extension does not send them to Tools Platform or any other third party.
扩展不会读取浏览器历史记录，也不会持续跟踪您访问的网页。: The extension does not read your browser history or continuously track the webpages you visit.
扩展不会将题目、选项、答案或完整题库上传至授权服务器。: The extension does not upload questions, options, answers, or complete question banks to the licensing server.
扩展不会收集姓名、邮箱、电话号码、支付信息、精确位置或通讯录。: The extension does not collect names, email addresses, phone numbers, payment information, precise location, or contacts.
扩展功能、数据处理方式或适用法律发生变化时，我们可能更新本政策。更新后的版本将在: We may update this policy when the extension's features, data processing practices, or applicable laws change. 扩展仅在您主动打开并启动时处理当前页面。: The extension processes the current page only when you actively open and start it.

目标网站对应的浏览器本地存储: Browser local storage for the target website

您可以联系管理员申请查询、更正或删除服务器端 License 记录，但须遵守适用: You can contact the administrator to request access to, correction of, or deletion of server-side License records, subject to applicable laws and security retention requirements.

任何网络或存储系统都无法保证绝对安全。用户应妥善保管 License 和导出的题: No network or storage system can guarantee absolute security. Users should safeguard their License and exported question bank files and run the extension only on trusted devices and websites.
如果您对本隐私政策、扩展的数据处理方式或数据请求有疑问，请联系 Tools Pl: If you have questions about this Privacy Policy, the extension's data processing practices, or data requests, contact the Tools Platform administrator:
如需查询或删除与 License 相关的服务器记录，请通过本政策末尾的联系方式联: To request access to or deletion of License-related server records, contact the administrator using the contact details at the end of this policy. Data required by law or needed for security audits may not be deleted immediately.
识别考试页中的题目、选项和答题反馈，整理成可搜索、可标注的本地题库。: Identifies questions, options, and answer feedback on exam pages and organizes them into a searchable, annotatable local question bank.
授权校验数据仅由 Tools Platform 授权基础设施及其管理员处理。除非: License validation data is processed only by the Tools Platform licensing infrastructure and its administrators. We do not disclose this data to other third parties unless required to comply with applicable laws, protect users or platform security, or fulfill an explicit user request.
数据不会用于广告画像，也不会被出售。: Data is not used for advertising profiles and will not be sold.
题库当前保存在目标网站对应的本地存储空间。清除该网站的浏览数据可能删除题库；反之: The question bank is currently stored in the local storage associated with the target website. Clearing the website's browsing data may delete the question bank; conversely, uninstalling the extension alone may not clear the website's existing local storage.
题库名称、题目、选项、已知答案、错误答案/组合、出现次数和本地标注。: Question bank name, questions, options, known answers, incorrect answers/combinations, occurrence counts, and local annotations.
题目、选项和答案不会由扩展上传到平台服务器。: Questions, options, and answers are not uploaded by the extension to platform servers.
我们不会出售用户数据，不会向数据经纪商提供数据，也不会使用数据进行个性化广告、信: We do not sell user data, provide data to data brokers, or use data for personalized advertising, credit assessment, or cross-site tracking.
我们不会将收集或处理的数据用于与上述功能无关的目的。: We do not use collected or processed data for purposes unrelated to the features described above.
我们通过本地优先处理、最小化联网数据、HTTPS 授权校验、随机 nonce、防: We reduce data risks through local-first processing, minimized network data, HTTPS license validation, random nonce, anti-replay signature verification, offline ECDSA P-256 signature verification, request rate limiting, and access controls.
验证 License 有效期和状态、提供可信时间、限制异常频繁请求并协助安全排障: Validate the License validity period and status, provide trusted time, limit unusually frequent requests, and assist with security troubleshooting.
用户主动启动后，扩展仅处理当前活动标签页中的考试内容。: Once explicitly started by the user, the extension only processes exam content in the current active tab.
用于在配置的目标考试网站运行，以及连接指定的 Tools Platform Li: Used to run on configured target exam websites and connect to the designated Tools Platform License validation endpoint. The extension does not use this permission to build a browsing history.
由用户主动将题库导出为 JSON，或从用户选择的 JSON 文件导入。: The user can explicitly export the question bank as JSON or import it from a user-selected JSON file.
在用户点击扩展并主动启动时访问当前标签页。: Accesses the current tab when the user clicks the extension and explicitly starts it.
在用户主动启动后，将当前题目与本地题库匹配，并在当前页面选择相应答案。: Once explicitly started by the user, matches the current question against the local question bank and selects the corresponding answer on the current page.
License 的产品、签发、有效期和状态记录，以及必要的安全日志，按平台管理员: License product, issuance, validity period, and status records, along with necessary security logs, are retained according to the platform administrator's security and operational retention policies.
License 密钥、产品标识、随机 nonce；授权服务还会接收常规网络信息，: License key, product identifier, and random nonce; the authorization service also receives standard network information such as the IP address, User-Agent, request time, and validation result.
